name: booth
description: Let Claude speak in natural voices on your own PC: lines, scripts and designed voices with the local ZONOS3-Mini engine.
long_description:
Booth runs the ZONOS3-Mini voice model on your computer. With this extension Claude can speak a line, render a script with several voices, design new voices (older, deeper, a British accent) and list your takes. Every take is saved as a WAV file in your Booth takes folder. Nothing leaves your PC.

Install the Booth app first: it downloads the voice model and runs the engine. Cloning a voice from a clip is off until you turn on "Let Claude clone voices" in Booth's settings.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Whether the voice engine is installed and running, which model packs are downloaded, and where takes are saved.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: The voices Booth can speak with: your own and the built-in ones.

tools.name: list_controls
tools.description: Voice controls (who, texture, room, delivery, mood, accents) with dose ranges and presets.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Speak one line and save it as a WAV take.

tools.name: render_script
tools.description: Render several lines, each with its own voice, into one WAV take.

tools.name: list_takes
tools.description: Recent takes, newest first, with file paths.

tools.name: design_voice
tools.description: Make a new voice by reshaping an existing one, and save it.

tools.name: create_voice
tools.description: Clone a voice from a clip (off unless you allow it in Booth's settings; consent required).
